outgoing.explanation: Anderson's GMD assessment cites the 1641 Massachusetts General Court gunpowder-fine order (MBCR 1:331) among its six documentary bases for John — the cited-record relationship behind the published arrival/settlement statement.

Anderson's published 1636 arrival and Boston/Braintree settlement (Weymouth excluded) is the standing published estimate; the pre-1643 Weymouth grants, the 'of Weymouth' 1641 petition, and the post-1640 Great Migration falloff revise the window to 1638-early 1641 and locate his first residence at the Weymouth Anderson omits.

statement: Robert Charles Anderson's Great Migration Directory (2nd ed., 2025), p. 158, records John Gurney with an arrival of 1636 and New England residences at Boston and Braintree (Weymouth not listed), while leaving his English origin 'Unknown' — the standing published assessment of John's arrival and settlement.
